evidence.title: Animation Video Peddled As NASA Releasing Footage Of ...

evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that a video shows Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander landing on the Moon's south pole, stating it is an animated clip.

evidence.title: 'NASA footage', 'Ashoka Stambh on lunar surface': Fake visuals ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as False the claim that NASA released footage of Chandrayaan landing on the moon and that the Ashoka Stambh will be imprinted on the lunar surface.

evidence.title: Fake video of Earth was not captured by India's spacecraft
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as False the claim that India's lunar spacecraft Chandrayaan 3 sent footage of Earth, stating it was a fake video.

evidence.title: Fact Check: Reports of Chandrayaan-3 landing on the moon and ...
evidence.snippet_en: Telugu Post rated as False the claim that Chandrayaan-3 has landed on the moon and discovered pure water on the moon’s surface.

evidence.title: No, BBC did not criticize Chandrayaan 3. Old clip viral; false report ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as False the claim that BBC slammed India's Chandrayaan 3 mission in view of poverty, stating it was an old clip and a false report.

evidence.title: Fact Check: This captivating photo of Earth from the Moon was not ...
evidence.snippet_en: India Today rated as False the claim that a photo of the Earth shot from the Moon’s surface was taken by Chandrayaan-3, stating it was AI-generated.

evidence.title: Fact-Check: Old Stock Video Shared as Visuals of Moon Captured ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that a video is recent and shows visuals of the moon that were captured by Chandrayaan-3, stating it was an old stock video.

evidence.title: Unrelated Visuals Passed Off as Live Visuals of Moon Captured by ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that a video is recent and shows live visuals of the moon captured by ISRO's Chandrayaan-3, stating it was unrelated visuals.

evidence.title: Fact Check: Video Depicting South Pole Of Moon Created With AI ...
evidence.snippet_en: Vishvas News rated as Half true the claim that a video shows a live image of the Moon's South Pole, stating it was created with an AI tool by mixing visuals of Mars.

evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as False the claim that China was the first country to land on the moon's South Pole a few years ago.

outputs.notes_en: No fact checks directly support or contradict the claims about Chandrayaan-3's historic landing, India joining an elite club for soft landing, or the Vikram lander's touchdown time. However, several fact checks contradict various false claims related to Chandrayaan-3's mission, such as fake footage, discovery of water, or other countries being first to the moon's south pole. One fact check provides context on a video depicting the moon's south pole.
